regeln: Vary sentence structure and descriptions dynamically across list items to completely avoid repetitive templates.
Ensure every item in a countdown or ranking highlights a distinctly unique use-case or capability without redundancy.
Omit dry metrics like star counts or download numbers unless they directly serve a crucial narrative purpose.
Craft high-stakes, engaging narrative outros and calls-to-action instead of relying on generic filler text.
Create a compelling narrative arc instead of relying on generic countdown lists that cause viewer drop-off.
Use unique and specific hooks instead of overused generic tech creator tropes.
Avoid prolonged static shots of documentation or code scrolling; switch visuals dynamically to maintain pacing.
Ensure every outro and call-to-action features relevant, high-context visuals instead of generic backgrounds.
Verify that every visual asset or screenshot accurately matches the technical reality of the software being discussed.
Maintain consistency when citing engagement metrics by sticking to a single verified source type.
Keep all text elements safely within the inner title-safe zone and away from the top and bottom edges.
Ensure captions and subtitles have sufficient padding to avoid being clipped by screen interfaces.
